title: Rust: Task Queue / Job Scheduler
description: Build a task queue with job scheduling, priorities, and worker pools.

steps.title: Job and Queue
steps.description: Define a `Job` struct with `id: u64`, `name: String`, `priority: u8`. Create a `JobQueue` using `VecDeque<Job>`. Implement `enqueue`, `dequeue`, and `peek`.
hints: `struct Job { id: u64, name: String, priority: u8 }`
Enqueue adds, dequeue pops from front (FIFO).

verification.failureMessage: Create and enqueue jobs, then dequeue and print.

steps.title: Priority Queue
steps.description: Convert to a priority queue using a `BinaryHeap<Job>` (where Job implements Ord by priority). Higher priority jobs are dequeued first. Test by enqueuing jobs with different priorities.
hints: `impl Ord for Job { fn cmp(&a, &b) -> Ordering { a.priority.cmp(&b.priority) } }`

verification.failureMessage: Enqueue low-pri and high-pri jobs, print dequeue order (high first).

steps.title: Worker Pool
steps.description: Create a `WorkerPool` that spawns `num_workers` threads. Workers pull jobs from a shared queue and execute them. Use `Arc<Mutex<JobQueue>>`. Print when each worker processes a job.
hints: Each worker loops, locks queue, pops job, processes.

verification.failureMessage: Submit 5 jobs to 3 workers and print processing messages.

steps.title: Job with Status Tracking
steps.description: Track job status: `Pending`, `Running`, `Completed`, `Failed`. Create a `JobTracker` that stores job statuses. Update status as jobs move through the queue. Print final status report.

verification.failureMessage: Run several jobs and print their final statuses.

steps.title: Scheduled Jobs
steps.description: Add scheduled execution: jobs can have a `run_at: Option<Instant>`. The queue only returns scheduled jobs after their time has passed. Test with immediate and delayed jobs.
hints: Dequeue only returns jobs where run_at is None or run_at <= now.
Simulate delayed jobs by creating them with `Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(10)`.

verification.failureMessage: Schedule immediate and delayed jobs and show they execute at the right time.
